MINUTES
  REGULAR PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
  March 20, 2017

A regular meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
Estates was called to order at 7:16 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chambers, 4045 Palos
Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR ROMANELLI.

COMMISSIONERS PRESENT: Giglia, Portugal, Retz, and Vice Chair Romanelli

COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Chair Pope, Persichina

STAFF PRESENT:  Andy Clark, Community Services Director

CHAIR ROMANELLI presented a plaque to COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL for her
service as Chair of the Park and Activities Commission from February 2016 to February
2017.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES, FEBRUARY 21, 2017

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL

  TO APPROVE THE CORRECTED DRAFT MEETING MINUTES OF
  FEBRUARY 21, 2017.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI SO ORDERED.

AUDIENCE ITEMS/WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS NOT ON THE AGENDA

None.

CONSENT CALENDAR

None.

BUSINESS ITEMS

A.  ACTION ITEM FROM THE PRIVATE YOUTH  SPORT  COACHING
  SUBCOMMITTEE MEETING OF MARCH 7, 2017

Community Services Director Clark stated that MuniServices has been working with the
City to investigate businesses in the City who do not have business licenses. If the
requirement for private coaching business licenses moves forward, MuniServices will
also be assigned this task.

Community Services Director Clark stated that at the request of Commissioner
Persichina, staff determined the cost of maintaining the field portion of the park and the
estimate is $109,000. The objective is that this is a cost the City incurs which justifies
charging a fee to private coaches using City property to conduct business.

COMMISSIONER GIGLIA asked if there is a general code for anyone using City property
to operate their business. In this case, should Code Enforcement staff be tasked with
this as well. Community Services Director agreed and stated that it should be both Code
Enforcement and MuniServices.

CHAIR ROMANELLI stated that the fee structure must be based on something definite.
A general discussion was held regarding fees.

Community Services Director stated that there are also private coaches/trainers who are
working as independent contractors, not using City facilities, who also need business
licenses. However, those using City facilities will also be required to provide insurance
and background checks.

REGULAR PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
MINUTES  1
MARCH 20, 2017
 COMMISSIONER GIGLIA stated that there is significant liability to the City if someone
were to get hurt on City property.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL

  TO RECOMMEND THAT CITY COUNCIL ADOPT A TWO-CATEGORY PRIVATE
  COACHING SPORTS FIELD PERMIT SYSTEM WITH FEES BASED ON USAGE
  (SIMILAR TO HORSE TRAINERS OR BASED ON HOURLY FIELD RENTAL
  RATES) AND REQUIRE THOSE PRIVATE COACHES USING CITY SPORTS
  FIELDS TO ANNUALLY PROVIDE THE CITY A CERTIFICATE OF LIABILITY
  INSURANCE (NAMING CITY AS ADDITIONALLY INSURED), SIGN A HOLD
  HARMLESS AGREEMENT, AND SUBMIT A CRIMINAL BACKGROUND CHECK
  WHEN SUBMITTING AN APPLICATION AND FEES FOR A COMMERCIAL
  RECREATION BUSINESS LICENSE.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI SO ORDERED.

B.  DRAFT PARK REGULATIONS SIGNAGE

Community Services Director Clark asked the Park and Activities Commission for input
on changes to the park regulations signage.

CHAIR ROMANELLI asked about the placement of the signs. Community Services
Director Clark provided suggestions installation locations.

COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that having too many regulations may seem oppressive.

COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL suggested that an e-mail address be included for non-
emergency information. The Community Services Director stated that 9-1-1 could be
added to the sign for park emergencies.

CHAIR ROMANELLI requested that one sign be tailored for each park.

  COMMISSIONER RETZ moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER GIGLIA to,

  TO MAKE A RECOMMENDATION TO THE CITY COUNCIL TO APPROVE
  THIS ITEM WITH THE FOLLOWING MODIFICATIONS: (1) INCLUDE AN
  E-MAIL ADDRESS FOR NON-EMERGENCY INQUIRIES/CONCERNS
  AND 9-1-1 FOR EMERGENCIES, AND (2) THE SIGNS TO BE
  TAILORED FOR EACH PARK.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI SO ORDERED.

C.  PROPOSED PARK TOUR SCHEDULE

Community Services Director Clark provided a brief overview of the proposed schedule.

  COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  APPROVE THE PROPOSED PARK TOUR SCHEDULE.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI SO ORDERED.

ADJOURN TO THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MEETING

  COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER GIGLIA to,

  ADJOURN TO THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD
  MEETING.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

REGULAR PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
MINUTES  2
MARCH 20, 2017
 A.  THE HILLS ARE ALIVE RACE CONSULTANT AGREEMENT

Community Services Director stated that the City Attorney reviewed the need for an
additional level of insurance several years ago and determined that the event is so small
and there is little exposure to the City and therefore professional and commercial
insurance is not required. However, auto liability insurance is required.

  COMMISSIONER  PORTUGAL  moved,  seconded  by  COMMISSIONER
  GIGLIA to,

  TO APPROVE THAT THE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MAKE A
  RECOMMENDATION TO THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BOARD OF
  DIRECTORS TO APPROVE THE CONSULTANT AGREEMENT WITH
  MICHAEL HOGUE PRODUCTIONS FOR THE 2017 HILLS ARE ALIVE
  RACE.

  AYES:  GIGLIA, PORTUGAL, RETZ, CHAIR ROMANELLI
  NOES:
  ABSTAIN:
  ABSENT:  CHAIR POPE, PERSICHINA

RECONVENE TO THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING

  COMMISSIONER RETZ moved to,

  RECONVENE TO THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI SO ORDERED.

COMMISSION ITEMS (VERBAL REPORTS)

A.  ADOPT-A-PARK REPORT

  COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that the fence footing at Dapplegray Park has not
  been set.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA stated that maintenance staff has been working hard to
  clean-up damage from the storm.

B.  JOINT CITY CELEBRATION AND 60TH ANNIVERSARY SUBCOMMITTEE
  MEETING UPDATE

C.  CITY CELEBRATION SUBCOMMITTEE MEETING UPDATE

D.  PARADE SUBCOMMITTEE DEBRIEFING MEETING UPDATE

  COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL stated that the most important take away was that
  the judges’ station needs to be moved back to the former location to avoid the
  problems with traffic.

E.  SOUTH BAY CITIES COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS GENERAL ASSEMBLY
  UPDATE

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA stated it was a good event and there was a good
  discussion on two cities who are providing high-speed internet for their residents.
  One city was able to provide it at no cost to the residents and the smaller city is
  struggling with the cost.

DIRECTOR’S ITEMS (VERBAL REPORTS)

A.  ANNUAL 700 FORM SUBMITTAL – Community Services Director Clark stated
  that the 700 form is due by April 3rd.

REGULAR PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
MINUTES  3
MARCH 20, 2017
 B.  HOWLETT PARK PLAY EQUIPMENT REPLACEMENT PROJECT – Community
  Services Director Clark stated that the equipment should arrive at the end of the
  month.

C.  LOS ANGELES COUNTY MEASURE “A” GRANT FUNDING INFORMATION –
  Community Services Director Clark stated that information will be provided at the
  next meeting.

D.  ERNIE HOWLETT PARK MURAL RIBBON CUTTING CEREMONY – MAY 15TH

E.  PV STREET FAIR & MUSIC FESTIVAL BOOTH SIGN-UP SHEET, JUNE 10-11TH
  Community Services Director Clark provided the Park and Activities
  Commissioners with a sign-up sheet.

MATTERS OF INFORMATION

A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF FEBRUARY 28, 2017

B.  PLANNING COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES OF MARCH 6, 2017

  Received and filed.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT

COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  ADJOURN THE PARKS AND ACTIVITIES MEETING

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI adjourned the meeting at 7:50
p.m. to the next Parks & Activities Commission Meeting of April 17, 2017.

Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

REGULAR PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
